name: Fishbowl
summary: A glass fishbowl trash: deleted files splash in and float, tap one to fish it back out
about: Fishbowl turns the trash into a little glass bowl with a goldfish, swaying weeds and rising bubbles. Deleting a file flings it in an arc into the bowl, where it splashes, startles the fish and sinks to bob among the others while the water level rises. Tap a floating file to fish it out and land it back on its tile; Empty turns every file into a bubble that rises and pops.
how: Press × on a file (or Tab to it and press Enter).
It arcs into the bowl, splashes, the fish darts away and the file sinks and keeps bobbing; the water rises a little.
Tap a floating file to restore it: it jumps out with a splash and lands back on its own tile.
Press Empty: the bowl wobbles and each file becomes a bubble that rises and pops for good.
Bring back the sample files puts emptied files back on the desk.
